cases.question: In Illustrator 28.0 ExtendScript, what happens when you read radialConfig / gridConfig / symmetryConfig on a Repeat item, and how does the skill set Repeat options instead?
cases.answer: The getters return "NULL pointer" in 28.0; use Object > Repeat > Options with a dialog plan.

cases.question: Saving a print PDF from an Illustrator script with pDFPreset = '[Press Quality]': what happens to the document bleed, and which PDFSaveOptions settings keep the bleed?
cases.answer: The preset resets the bleed to 0 in the saved PDF; leave pDFPreset unset and use pDFXStandard = PDFXStandard.PDFX1A2001 + trimMarks = true.
cases.source: SKILL.md Pitfalls (verified with the PDF's BleedBox)

cases.question: In this skill, a script selects objects and runs app.executeMenuCommand() in the same run_js call, and the command acts on the old selection or does nothing. Why, and what is the fix?
cases.answer: Illustrator refreshes command targets only when idle: select in one run_js call, run the menu command in the next.
